description: This Java class defines an immutable data object 'DepositAccountData' representing deposit accounts (fixed and recurring) in the Fineract system. It encapsulates properties related to deposit accounts, including identifiers, interest details, associations, charges, and options. It provides constructors and static factory methods for creating instances with specific data, and methods for accessing associated charges.

classes.name: DepositAccountData
classes.description: Immutable data object representing deposit accounts, including their properties, associations, and options.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new DepositAccountData instance with specified core details and charges.

methods.name: lookup
methods.description: Static method to create a minimal DepositAccountData instance with given ID, account number, and deposit type.

methods.name: getWithdrawalFee
methods.description: Private helper method to retrieve the withdrawal fee charge from charges collection.

methods.name: getAnnualFee
methods.description: Private helper method to retrieve the annual fee charge from charges collection.
